name: Maki
tagline: Conversational AI agents that source, screen, interview, and assess candidates end to end.
description: Maki runs hiring as AI agents across five stages — intake, screening, assessment, interview, and hire recommendation — layered on top of a company's existing ATS and HRIS. Its agents interview candidates by voice, video, or text and evaluate skills using proprietary models and psychometric science. It targets high-volume, enterprise talent teams, with customers including H&M, BNP Paribas, PwC, Deloitte, and FIFA.
insight: Founded 2022; raised a $28.6M Series A in January 2025 led by Blossom Capital, with DST Global participating.
edge: Runs the whole top-of-funnel — sourcing, screening, and voice/video/text interviews with skill assessment — as AI agents layered on your existing ATS.
pros: Audited for bias by New York State
cons: Candidate trust in AI interviews varies

references.title: As Gen Z job applicants balloon, companies are turning to AI agent recruiters
